description: Import Pipeline Configuration — Offset Registry, Paths & Processing Defaults

paths._comment_import_timings: The measured duration of each import step, written once after a complete import into the production archive and read for the next import's estimate. Derived and deletable: without it the screen shows no estimate.

processing._comment_render_timeframes: Which timeframes the import materializes. Each one costs a parquet file per symbol, so this is a cost knob, not the vocabulary — a name absent here still exists and can be added without code changes. Must name timeframes the registry knows.

display._comment: The live screen of `data_index_cli.py import`. Off, or with stdout not a terminal, the import logs line by line instead; --no-display switches it off for one run.
